represented_appearance: Open pier, using May 2011 Street View and pre-closure architect photography for appearance; 2023/2024 engineering reports for retained structural dimensions. Decay and closure works are not reconstructed.

sources.observations: Figure 2-4, page 8: four trusses spaced 2.386/2.265/2.288 m, north cantilever 1.012 m, typical bays 15.25 m, generally 178 mm cast-iron columns. Pages 54-55 distinguish four railing types. Report photos supply underside and bearing evidence.
Longitudinal outer decking, transverse central boards; separate above-deck trusses at Marine Drive with transverse boards throughout. Southern entrance widening has transverse boards.

Pavilion completed 2002, 585 square metres, 45 m southwest glass wall. Photos 03/05 show inclined walls, exposed V-columns, blue cladding, rolled roof edge, entrance recess; 06/08 show glass wall and underside columns; 07 shows rail and boarding arrangement.
Level entrance beside Funland, flared southern deck, blue and ivory railings, yellow track boundary strips. Walked along pier with separate panoramas.
Crossing ivory arch pairs, crown motif and hanging blue lantern; horizontal rails both sides over lake; adjacent Marine Way Bridge provides relative clearance check.
Arches continue seaward, north diamond rail posts, south pickets and wind panels; regular bins, benches and small floodlights.

Actual textured Google 3D orbited around pier, Marine Drive crossing and Ocean Plaza. Confirms long straight deck, bridge trusses, side kiosks and pavilion widening; fine rail/column geometry below imagery resolution.
Provisional geographic registration and widening positions, checked against aerial imagery. Not treated as architectural measurements.
